summary: Static site built with Astro and served free from Cloudflare Pages; no backend or database to run.

architecture_rationale.text: No server-side needs (no accounts, payments or user data), so pre-built pages on a CDN: nothing to run or patch. Microservices rejected: 1 engineer(s) cannot absorb their operational overhead.

frontend.justification: Pre-renders pages to static HTML with zero JS by default. Fit for this project: team.languages includes JavaScript; well suited to content site projects; strong cost, which you rated 5/5; seo_critical=true and it serves pre-rendered HTML.

alternatives.why_not: Lower overall fit: app framework is heavier than this content site needs; the chosen option wins on project.type (well suited to content site projects).

tradeoffs: Rich app-like interactivity needs islands; large SPAs are a poor fit.

backend.justification: The site has no server-side logic. Fit for this project: static content needs no server: nothing to run, patch or pay for; strong cost, which you rated 5/5; strong time to market, which you rated 4/5.
